correctness.rationale: For angular Brownian exit T from (−L,L), generator D∂² and independent Exp(κ) E, solve backward ODE: F=E[e^(−κT)]=cosh(uz)/cosh z, u=|θ0|/L,z=L√(κ/D). Conditional E[T|T<E]=−F’/F and E[E|E<T]=1/κ+F’/(1−F), so signed difference is H(z,u)/[κ(1−F)]. H(z,0)>0, H(z,u)<0 near u=1; its derivative changes from negative to positive exactly once since Q(w)=sech(w)+(w/sinh w)sech²w decreases. Exactly one interior zero follows. Taylor expansion gives u_c=1/√5+(8√5/1875)z²+O(z⁴); u=1−w/z limit w/2−1+exp(−w) yields w*=1.59362426004... positive root. Independently numerically evaluated thresholds z=.2..40 and confirmed strong layer; analytic proof covers all positive parameters.
residual_risks: Model is only one sticking episode with unbiased D>0 and constant killing κ>0; does not cover return trajectories or nonexponential killing.
